newsitem.title: USA: Dyna Group 1996 net falls as margins drop.
newsitem.headline: Dyna Group 1996 net falls as margins drop.

text.p: Dyna Group International Inc said Thursday a sharp drop in its gross margins caused 1996 earnings to plunge.
The company reported net income of $31,487, or nil per share, versus $204,325, or $0.03 a share, one year ago. Sales increased to $10.9 million from $10.0 million in 1995.
Dyna Group attributed the decline in gross margins to a substantial reduction to its year-end physical inventory values. The company added it believes it will be able to raise margins in 1997.
Dyna Group develops and markets specialty branded pewter merchandise and licensed products.
Its shares closed off 3/32 Thursday at 3/4.
